registry_entry.intent: Add opt-in OpenTelemetry distributed tracing to the Cicadas CLI so each initiative produces a single linked trace from kickoff through archive, exported via OTLP HTTP to any configurable backend.

feat/tracing-core.intent: Create the core tracing.py module with OTel null-object fallback, add the optional tracing dependency group to pyproject.toml, and add the tracing config stub to init.py's generated config.json template.

feat/tracing-instrumentation.intent: Instrument kickoff, branch, archive, emit_event, and command_registry with OTel spans linked via persisted trace_context, plus LLM call spans and graceful fallback when the SDK is absent
